quotes.author: Dustin Harrison
quotes.text: Me and 3 other guys drove 5 hours and paid $1700 and the actual captain did not show up and didn’t notify us that he wasn’t coming. And the replacement captain was 2 hours late getting there and we didn’t even go that far out and only caught one fish service was terrible and the replacement captain was to busy talking about his sex life to even find any fish we left with one small shark after paying 1700 dollars and most all the other charters came back with a lot of fish. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS CHARTER.

quotes.author: CJ craemer
quotes.text: Wow, I couldn't be happier. I was told that the fish were around but you had to go with a decent guy to really get them. Well, let me tell you, Tom really knew what he was doing! What a great guy, and professional on the boat. We caught more than I anticipated and he and his mate took the time to help us get the perfect picture to bring home to the family. I will be back soon and cant wait for next season now that I have a guy to rely on! Thanks Tom!

quotes.author: Mike Harpster
quotes.text: Captain Tom and 1st class mate Joe took us on a hybrid trip. The striped bass had not been hitting but 2 of my grandsons and I wanted to spend a bit of time trolling for a big boy on the Tommy Boy. The Captain agreed to an unusual hybrid trip. Although we had no luck the time was spent with lots of great discussion and laughter. Better luck with the flukes had us taking home 8 nice filets. Thanks to Captain and Joe for a great day.

quotes.author: William Beasley
quotes.text: Tommy boy charters were awesome, I would go again in a heartbeat. Captain Thomas and the mate Joe made us feel comfortable and put us on some great fishing. Other than losing our 6th fish at the net we came home with some really nice keeper's. No worries Joe! You were awesome, thanks for a great trip.

quotes.author: Andrew Eichelberger
quotes.text: My 8 year old son and I did an afternoon trip yesterday and had a great time. Captain Tom worked hard to ensure we had good outing. My son caught around 20 fish -- he said his arm was getting tired from reeling them in! Would highly recommend Captain Tom and Tommy Boy Fishing Charter

quotes.author: Thomas Shannon
quotes.text: Me and my dad had a fantastic time with captain Tom we talked about funny stories and we caught a lot fish different species. One of the best captains I ever had if you have a question or a request don’t be afraid to ask they will help you, fantastic captain and crew
